title: AiBatchCreateResult
description: ai.batch-create-result@1: the answers of ai.batches.create on OpenVibe.AI. POST /api/v1/batches → 201 { batch }; POST /api/v1/batches/:id/cancel → { batch }. Cancelling only touches the prompts that never had a run: they are cancelled and are not charged for. A prompt that already has a run (the provider is working on it) goes on and settles on its own path: it keeps its status, the answer says so, and nobody is told it was not charged. The batch itself is cancelled only when nothing is left in flight.
